# Skills on AI

> A catalog of 1105 AI agent skills in 71 categories. Each skill is one SKILL.md file: YAML frontmatter (name, description with trigger conditions) followed by a Markdown body. Fetch a skill's raw file at https://skills-on-ai.org/skills/<name>/SKILL.md.

Source: https://github.com/skills-on-ai/skills-on-ai

## Fitness

- [Balance and Stability Fitness](https://skills-on-ai.org/skills/balance-and-stability-fitness/SKILL.md): Use when asked for guidance on balance and stability training — proprioception, single-leg work, and why this matters across ages and fitness levels.
- [Bodyweight Fitness](https://skills-on-ai.org/skills/bodyweight-fitness/SKILL.md): Use when asked for guidance on bodyweight training (calisthenics) — progressions, common movement patterns, and building strength without equipment.
- [Cardio Fitness](https://skills-on-ai.org/skills/cardio-fitness/SKILL.md): Use when asked for guidance on cardiovascular (cardio) fitness training — heart-rate zones, steady-state vs. interval training, and building an aerobic base.
- [Core Fitness](https://skills-on-ai.org/skills/core-fitness/SKILL.md): Use when asked for guidance on core training — training beyond visible abs, anti-extension/rotation work, and how core strength supports other fitness goals.
- [Crossfit Fitness](https://skills-on-ai.org/skills/crossfit-fitness/SKILL.md): Use when asked for guidance on CrossFit-style training — constantly varied, high-intensity functional movement, scaling for beginners, and the role of coaching.
- [Endurance Fitness](https://skills-on-ai.org/skills/endurance-fitness/SKILL.md): Use when asked for guidance on endurance training — building toward sustained, longer-duration performance (running, cycling, swimming, or multi-sport events).
- [Flexibility and Mobility Fitness](https://skills-on-ai.org/skills/flexibility-and-mobility-fitness/SKILL.md): Use when asked for guidance on flexibility and mobility training — static vs. dynamic stretching, when to use each, and building a mobility routine.
- [Functional Fitness](https://skills-on-ai.org/skills/functional-fitness/SKILL.md): Use when asked for guidance on functional fitness training — movements that mimic real-world activities, multi-joint patterns, and training for everyday capability rather than isolated muscle size.
- [Group Fitness](https://skills-on-ai.org/skills/group-fitness/SKILL.md): Use when asked for guidance on group fitness classes — choosing a class type, getting the most from group instruction, and how it compares to solo training.
- [Hiit Fitness](https://skills-on-ai.org/skills/hiit-fitness/SKILL.md): Use when asked for guidance on HIIT (high-intensity interval training) — structuring work/rest intervals, who it's suited for, and recovery demands.
- [Home Gym Fitness](https://skills-on-ai.org/skills/home-gym-fitness/SKILL.md): Use when asked for guidance on building a home gym — prioritizing equipment, space and budget trade-offs, and getting real training value without a commercial gym.
- [Injury Prevention Fitness](https://skills-on-ai.org/skills/injury-prevention-fitness/SKILL.md): Use when asked for guidance on injury prevention in fitness training — warm-up, gradual progression, and recognizing early warning signs before they become serious injuries.
- [Personal Training Fitness](https://skills-on-ai.org/skills/personal-training-fitness/SKILL.md): Use when asked for guidance on working with a personal trainer — what to look for in a trainer, how to set goals together, and getting the most value from sessions.
- [Pilates](https://skills-on-ai.org/skills/pilates/SKILL.md): Use when asked for guidance on Pilates as a fitness discipline — core-centered control, breath coordination, and mat vs. equipment-based practice.
- [Powerlifting](https://skills-on-ai.org/skills/powerlifting/SKILL.md): Use when asked for guidance on powerlifting — the squat, bench press, and deadlift as a competitive or training discipline, including programming and form fundamentals.
- [Prenatal Fitness](https://skills-on-ai.org/skills/prenatal-fitness/SKILL.md): Use when asked for guidance on prenatal fitness — safe exercise during pregnancy, exercises and positions to modify or avoid, and the importance of medical guidance.
- [Progress Tracking Fitness](https://skills-on-ai.org/skills/progress-tracking-fitness/SKILL.md): Use when asked for guidance on tracking fitness progress — what metrics to track for different goals, and avoiding over-reliance on any single number.
- [Recovery and Rest Fitness](https://skills-on-ai.org/skills/recovery-and-rest-fitness/SKILL.md): Use when asked for guidance on fitness recovery and rest — sleep, rest days, and recognizing overtraining — the often-neglected counterpart to training itself.
- [Senior Fitness](https://skills-on-ai.org/skills/senior-fitness/SKILL.md): Use when asked for guidance on fitness training for older adults — balancing strength, balance, and cardiovascular training with safety and mobility considerations.
- [Sports Nutrition Fitness](https://skills-on-ai.org/skills/sports-nutrition-fitness/SKILL.md): Use when asked for guidance on sports/fitness nutrition — protein needs, pre/post-workout fueling, and hydration for training and performance.
- [Strength Training Fitness](https://skills-on-ai.org/skills/strength-training-fitness/SKILL.md): Use when asked for guidance on strength training — progressive overload, compound lifts, and program structure for someone building a resistance-training routine.
- [Warm Up and Cool Down Fitness](https://skills-on-ai.org/skills/warm-up-and-cool-down-fitness/SKILL.md): Use when asked for guidance on structuring a workout warm-up and cool-down — what each should include and why both matter for performance and recovery.
